Synopsis:
Eskom posted a post-tax profit of ZAR 30.3bn for FY ending March 2026, more than doubling the prior year's ZAR 14.0bn. The turnaround is driven by higher tariffs, cost discipline and operational recovery. Load-shedding dropped sharply to just 4 days in the year vs. 13 the prior year and a record 329 days in 2024, signalling a material structural improvement in South Africa's power supply reliability.

Q02. Is the content confirming already known information or reporting very new/uncertain risks?
Risk score: 10 — Eskom's operational recovery has been a known, ongoing trend. The scale of improvement is notable but not surprising given the trajectory already in the public domain. No new or uncertain risk is introduced.
